title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and a translation vector of zero, zero, and zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of six lines. The first line starts from the origin and extends to the point (0.0339, 0). The second line moves vertically to (0.0339, 0.0339). The third line shifts left to (0.0319, 0.0339). The fourth line descends to (0.0319, 0.002). The fifth line continues horizontally to (0, 0.002), and the sixth line returns to the origin. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0339. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it with the same vector. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Finally, create a new solid body from this extrusion. The resulting dimensions are a length of 0.03393665158371041 units, a width of 0.03393665158371041 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0339, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0339, 0.0339) \
     .lineTo(0.0319, 0.0339) \
     .lineTo(0.0319, 0.002) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.002) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# Note: CAD-Query does not directly support Euler angles, but we can use rotate and translate methods
# The given Euler angles (-90, 0, -90) correspond to a rotation of 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The translation vector is [0, 0, 0], so no translation is needed

# Final model
r = r

# Display the model

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# L-angle profile dimensions
L = 0.0339   # leg length of the angle
t = 0.0113   # material thickness

# Sketch the L profile on the YZ plane (normal along +X) and extrude along X
r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(L, 0.0)
    .lineTo(L, t)
    .lineTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(t, L)
    .lineTo(0.0, L)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.75)
)

import cadquery as cq

s = 0.0339
t = 0.005
L = 0.7500

r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .polyline([
        (0, 0),
        (s, 0),
        (s, s),
        (s - t, s),
        (s - t, t),
        (0, t),
    ])
    .close()
    .extrude(L)
)
